frame: ICRS; Cartesian axes: +x toward (RA=0h, Dec=0), +y toward (RA=6h, Dec=0), +z toward the north celestial pole; unit pc; origin = Solar System barycentre (archive distances are heliocentric, difference negligible)
selectionRule: Host-level values are copied from the host's planet rows. If rows disagree (composite table), the most frequent (value, err1, err2, lim, ref) tuple wins; ties -> smaller mean relative uncertainty -> first planet in row order. Disagreeing parameters are listed in stVarying.

conventions.nulls: null = value not available in the archive (never 0, never invented)
conventions.uncertainties: <col>err1 = upper (+) uncertainty (>= 0), <col>err2 = lower (-) uncertainty (<= 0), same unit as <col>; null when not reported (archive-calculated values never carry uncertainties)
conventions.limitFlags: flag: 1 = value is an upper limit, -1 = value is a lower limit, 0 = measured value (null when the value is null)
conventions.references: Every *_refIdx is a 0-based row index into references.json rows ([refstr, label, url, kind]); kind "calculated" = value computed by the archive (see https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html)
conventions.dates: ISO-8601 calendar dates (UTC date, no time of day); archive time-of-day components (no time zone given) are dropped
conventions.coordinates: ra/dec ICRS decimal degrees; epoch per position source (J2015.5 for TIC v8); not propagated
conventions.rowOrder: rows sorted by hostname (code-point order), then orbital period ascending (nulls last), then semi-major axis, then pl_name; a host's planets are contiguous
conventions.composite: PSCompPars values for one planet can come from different references and need not be mutually self-consistent (see docs)

descriptions.hostname: Host star name (archive hostname); unique key; matches planets.json hostname
descriptions.raDeg: Right ascension (archive ra), ICRS. Epoch: posEpochJyr
descriptions.posEpochJyr: Epoch of raDeg/decDeg: 2015.5 when the position source is TIC v8 (Gaia DR2-based); null = epoch not stated by the source (literature positions, mostly microlensing hosts; proper motions negligible)
descriptions.xPc: DERIVED ICRS Cartesian x = distPc*cos(dec)*cos(ra) (toward RA=0h, Dec=0); rounded to 1e-6 pc; null if distPc is null
descriptions.yPc: DERIVED ICRS Cartesian y = distPc*cos(dec)*sin(ra) (toward RA=6h, Dec=0); rounded to 1e-6 pc; null if distPc is null
descriptions.zPc: DERIVED ICRS Cartesian z = distPc*sin(dec) (toward the north celestial pole); rounded to 1e-6 pc; null if distPc is null
descriptions.nPlanets: Number of planets.json rows with this hostname
descriptions.planetRows: Indices (0-based) of this host's planets in planets.json rows, ordered by orbital period (nulls last); always contiguous and ascending
descriptions.sy_snum: Number of stars in the planetary system
descriptions.sy_pnum: Number of confirmed planets in the system (counts planets of all stars of a multiple system, so it can exceed the number of rows with this hostname)
descriptions.sy_mnum: Number of moons in the system
descriptions.st_spectype: Host star spectral type (MK classification) as published
descriptions.st_metratio: Metallicity ratio used for st_met: '[Fe/H]', '[M/H]' or '[m/H]' (as given by the archive)
descriptions.st_logg: Stellar surface gravity as log10(g / (cm s^-2))
descriptions.sy_vmag: Johnson V magnitude of the system
descriptions.gaia_dr3_id: Gaia DR3 designation, e.g. 'Gaia DR3 5853498713190525696' (string: the source_id exceeds 2^53)
descriptions.stVarying: Names of host-level parameters whose central values differ between this host's planet rows in PSCompPars (composite table); the value shown is the most frequent one (see docs). Empty array = consistent
